mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates erode valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 2% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts for four consecutive months signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as construction and materials sector earnings fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings for industrial firms fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% for six consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates increase discount rates and reduce valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).
